title: Diagonal simulator component identity
statement: The component $W$ of the square diagonal simulator is equal to the machine obtained by composing the preliminary machine with the universal machine using buffered composition.
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the square diagonal simulator or its component $W$, so the intended meaning of that component cannot be confirmed from the payload alone.
replaced:
The work-tape component of the square diagonal simulator is the machine obtained by
buffering the preliminary machine with the universal machine.
